name: Temporal Graph Link Prediction Benchmark
description: A benchmark designed to evaluate link prediction heuristics and models on temporal (time-evolving) graphs.
reputation: Relevant to the temporal-graph research community with growing use for evaluating dynamic link-prediction models, but not yet a ubiquitous standard across all graph-learning work.
notes: Risk of temporal leakage if train/test splits are not strictly time-ordered; performance sensitive to snapshot granularity and evaluation protocol; datasets often non-stationary and heterogeneous in size.
